events.headline: BALL Q3 Earnings Beat on Higher Volumes and Favorable Price/Mix

lifecycle.authority: Retained structured Lifecycle authority; Markdown and SQLite not read

providers.reason: Ball reported a solid Q3 beat on both lines, driven by 4.7% global volume growth and record EMEA operating earnings. Management reaffirmed a confident outlook for 10%+ EPS growth in 2026 and noted that 2027 volumes are already effectively fully contracted, providing high visibility for near-term performance.
providers.risk: A projected $30 million headwind in Q4 from metal pass-through timing and startup costs could limit immediate upside.
